Definition: to plan, usually in a bad sense
BiblicalUsage: 1) to have a thought, devise, plan, consider, purpose; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to consider, fix thought upon; 1a2) to purpose, devise; 1a3) to plot (of evil intent)
